text_en: Love righteousness, you rulers of the earth, think of the Lord in goodness and seek him with sincerity of heart;
text_cn: 统治世界的人，你们应爱正义， 对上主应有正确的观念，应以诚朴的心寻求上主，

text_en: because he is found by those who do not put him to the test, and manifests himself to those who do not distrust him.
text_cn: 因为，凡不试探上主的，都可以寻到上主；对上主不失信的，上主必向他显示。

text_en: For perverse thoughts separate people from God, and when his power is tested, it exposes the foolish;
text_cn: 邪曲的思想，使人离开天主；愚人试探全能者，只有使自己蒙羞，

text_en: because wisdom will not enter a deceitful soul, or dwell in a body enslaved to sin.
text_cn: 因为，智慧不进入存心不良的灵魂里，也不住在一个屈服于罪恶的身体内。

text_en: For a holy and disciplined spirit will flee from deceit, and will leave foolish thoughts behind, and will be ashamed at the approach of unrighteousness.
text_cn: 实在，施训的圣神，远避欺诈，远离无知的思念；不义一到，即刻退去。

text_en: For wisdom is a kindly spirit, but will not free blasphemers from the guilt of their words; because God is witness of their inmost feelings, and a true observer of their hearts, and a hearer of their tongues.
text_cn: 智慧是爱人的神，口出咒语的人，她必惩罚；因为天主洞悉他的内心，确切监视他的心灵，听闻他的言语；

text_en: Because the spirit of the Lord has filled the world, and that which holds all things together knows what is said,
text_cn: 实在，上主的神充满了世界，包罗万象，通晓一切语言。

text_en: therefore those who utter unrighteous things will not escape notice, and justice, when it punishes, will not pass them by.
text_cn: 为此，谈论不义之事的，无不终被识破；执行报复的正义，也决不会将他放过。

text_en: For inquiry will be made into the counsels of the ungodly, and a report of their words will come to the Lord, to convict them of their lawless deeds;
text_cn: 因为恶人的思念，必将受审讯；上主听到他的言语，必惩罚他的罪行。

text_en: because a jealous ear hears all things, and the sound of grumbling does not go unheard.
text_cn: 原来天主嫉恶的耳朵，能听万事；连低声的怨言，也隐藏不住。

text_en: Beware then of useless grumbling, and keep your tongue from slander; because no secret word is without result, and a lying mouth destroys the soul.
text_cn: 所以，你们要谨防无益的怨言，禁止口舌，别说毁谤的话；因为暗中的言语，决不会空空过去；说谎的口舌，必杀害灵魂。

text_en: Do not invite death by the error of your life, or bring on destruction by the works of your hands;
text_cn: 不要因生活堕落而自招丧亡，也不要因你们双手的作为而自取灭亡，

text_en: because God did not make death, and he does not delight in the death of the living.
text_cn: 因为天主并未造死亡，也不乐意生灵灭亡。

text_en: For he created all things so that they might exist; the generative forces of the world are wholesome, and there is no destructive poison in them, and the dominion of Hades is not on earth.
text_cn: 他造了万物，为叫它们生存；世上的生物都有生命力，本身都没有致命的毒素，阴府在地上也没有权势；
因为正义是不死不灭的。

text_en: But the ungodly by their words and deeds summoned death; considering him a friend, they pined away and made a covenant with him, because they are fit to belong to his company.
text_cn: 但是，不义的人，因自己的言行自招死亡，与死亡相爱相恋，结立盟约，实堪作死亡的伴侣。
